headline: 9 core/governance contracts catalogued on Ethereum from the official docs; the full market list and operations contracts were not fetchable this run.

findings.text: No block-explorer name-tag search or read-API call was performed this run because the fetch budget was exhausted. The only fetch tool was web_fetch, and etherscan.io was never fetched.

The official docs page https://docs.resupply.finance/faq/contract-addresses was fetched. It lists 9 Ethereum addresses with roles: Core, Governance Token, Stablecoin, Treasury, Vest Manager, Registry, Governance Staker, Voter and Emissions Controller. It points to deployment/contracts.json on GitHub for the full list.

The audit_links URL https://docs.resupply.fi/faq/audits returned only the docs landing page, with no audit list or scope tables. The GitHub README lists yAudit and Chain Security as auditors. No audit PDF was opened, so no in-scope addresses were extracted.

The GitHub repo root was fetched and has audits/, deployment/ and script/ folders. deployment/contracts.json (named as authoritative by the docs) was NOT fetched because the fetch budget ran out. No commit SHA was pinned.
Only one chain (Ethereum) is pinned, and the docs state the contracts are on Ethereum mainnet. No other chains were found.
No factory enumeration was done. The Pair Deployer V2 address appeared only in a search snippet, and the PAIR_* market addresses live in contracts.json, which was not fetched.
Roles were assigned from the docs labels only. Tentative mapping: Voter is governor, Governance Staker is other, and all actor_class values are 'unknown' because no bytecode was read.
Every address in admin_addresses[] comes from the fetched docs page. Addresses seen only in search snippets are listed in unknowns[] under D8.

rationale.verdict: Walked the website, the official docs contract page and the GitHub repo root, and catalogued 9 Ethereum addresses. Per-market pairs, operations contracts and on-chain verification were not reached this run.

evidence.shows: Website describing reUSD borrowing against crvUSD/frxUSD lent in Curve Lend / Fraxlend, with an Insurance Pool. It links to docs.resupply.finance, gov.resupply.finance and github.com/resupplyfi/resupply, and claims 'immutable and non-custodial smart contracts' (a marketing claim, not verified on-chain).

Official contract address page listing Core 0xc07e000044F95655c11fda4cD37F70A94d7e0a7d, Governance Token 0x419905009e4656fdC02418C7Df35B1E61Ed5F726, Stablecoin 0x57aB1E0003F623289CD798B1824Be09a793e4Bec, Treasury 0x4444444455bF42de586A88426E5412971eA48324, Vest Manager 0x6666666677B06CB55EbF802BB12f8876360f919c, Registry 0x10101010E0C3171D894B71B3400668aF311e7D94, Governance Staker 0x22222222E9fE38F6f1FC8C61b25228adB4D8B953, Voter 0x11111111084a560ea5755Ed904a57e5411888C28 and Emissions Controller 0x33333333df05b0D52edD13D230461E5A0f5a4706. It also links to deployment/contracts.json on GitHub for the complete list.

Fetched the pinned audit_links URL; it returned only the docs welcome page. The page describes Resupply as a decentralized stablecoin protocol that lets users supply crvUSD/frxUSD to Curve Lend / Fraxlend and borrow reUSD. It lists no audit reports.

Public Foundry repo (MIT) with audits/, deployment/, disclosures/, script/ and src/ folders. The README lists yAudit and Chain Security as auditors and points to docs.resupply.fi. It describes Resupply as a CDP-based stablecoin protocol.
Search-result listing (snippet only; page not directly fetched) of yAudit reports for Resupply Finance (December 2024), Resupply post-hack fixes (July 2025), Resupply sreUSD and Resupply Curvelend.

unknowns: D1-offchain: No on-chain fetch (etherscan.io name-tag search or defipunkd read API) was attempted this run because the web_fetch budget was exhausted after the docs and GitHub fetches. No address_book surfacers were pinned.
D1: Etherscan name-tag search for 'Resupply' / 'reUSD' / 'RSUP' was not performed. Neighbouring Multisig / Timelock labels remain undiscovered.
D2: docs.resupply.finance lists no governance multisig, timelock or guardian addresses. Docs pages for governance or security may list them but were not walked.

D3: No audit PDFs were opened. Search snippets show the GitHub audits/ folder holds ChainSecurity (Resupply, v2, CurveLend Operators, sreUSD), Electisec (CurveLendOperator, Inflation-Fixes, sreUSD) and rsup_yaudit_report PDFs, but the folder fetch was denied. Scope address tables were not extracted.

D4: https://github.com/resupplyfi/resupply/blob/main/deployment/contracts.json was not fetched. The PAIR_* lending markets (crvUSD and frxUSD collateral pairs) and reward streams are not catalogued. No commit SHA was pinned. script/ broadcast artifacts were not walked.
D5: No other chains were checked; the pinned chain is Ethereum only.
D6: Pair registry or factory enumeration (Registry getAllPairAddresses or similar, Pair Deployer V2) was not performed. Every lending pair is therefore uncatalogued.

D8: The following addresses appeared only in search snippets of docs.resupply.finance/faq/contract-addresses and were not confirmed by a full fetch, so they are not in admin_addresses[]: Voter (active) 0x11111111063874cE8dC6232cb5C1C849359476E6; Savings reUSD (sreUSD) 0x557AB1e003951A73c12D16F0fEA8490E39C33C35; Insurance Pool 0x00000000efe883b3304aFf71eaCf72Dbc3e1b577; Pair Deployer V2 0x5555555558B7309ecB0FbB23e609ec3c6f74C2Ea; Redemption Operator (proxy) 0x3F7C15d053Ab332D194D0040815E466d34387E40; Redemption Handler 0x5eeB063d0abefBBc78F576E28d762a16b637A025; Liquidation Handler 0x88888888c227c36401493Ed9F3e3Dcc3800B2634; Borrow Limit Controller 0x0950000465476F4470e74AeD93E7dd414012BB7D. The snippet also lists a Keeper whose address was truncated.

D8: The fetched docs page lists Voter 0x11111111084a560ea5755Ed904a57e5411888C28, but a search snippet of the same docs lists an 'active' Voter at 0x11111111063874cE8dC6232cb5C1C849359476E6. The two sources conflict; the docs page may have been updated or cached differently. A downstream slice should check Core/Registry on-chain for the current voter.

D8: Address 0x6e90c85a495d54c6d7e1f3400fef1f6e59f86bd6 (a Resupply pair/vault targeted in an exploit, per third-party reports in search snippets) was not verified. It is a pair candidate for a later run.
D8: The docs.resupply.fi/faq/contract-addresses snippet shows an older address set (the Voter above) than the .finance domain. Which domain is canonical is unconfirmed.

D7: actor_class is 'unknown' for all entries because no bytecode or on-chain reads were performed. Core, Treasury, Registry and Voter may be owner/authority contracts or multisigs; this is not determined.
D3-audit-meta: Audit dates other than yAudit's Dec 2024 report are unverified. The ChainSecurity and Electisec reports have no verified dates.

protocol_metadata.about: Resupply lets users supply crvUSD or frxUSD to Curve Lend or Fraxlend markets and borrow the reUSD stablecoin against those lending positions. Each collateral market is a CDP-style pair. An Insurance Pool, funded by staked reUSD, covers liquidations and acts as a reserve against distressed collateral. Governance and emissions run through the RSUP token.
